pr.title: Parallelize generated sync
pr.body: Runs profile and preference writes concurrently.

diff: hard_async_race_condition Task.async writes preferences before profile transaction commits
code_after: profile_task = Task.async(fn -> upsert_profile(user) end); prefs_task = Task.async(fn -> upsert_preferences(user.id) end)

expectedClaims.description: Generated parallel sync can write preferences before the profile transaction commits.

knownNonIssues.description: Using Task.async is allowed here; the bug is the dependency ordering.

traps.kind: scary-looking code that is safe by itself
